name: Richmond District
label: Above market value
overview: Richmond District is a landmark residential project by Mira Developments that redefines what urban living looks like in Dubai. Located in the heart of Al Furjan, this development brings together five residential buildings and a dedicated office tower, all connected through a shared podium featuring retail outlets, wellness spaces, and premium leisure facilities. What truly distinguishes Richmond District is its collaboration with the iconic John Richmond brand a name synonymous with fashion-forward design and confident elegance. Every residence is delivered fully furnished, bearing the signature aesthetic of bold lines, rich textures, and contemporary sophistication. This is not just a place to live; it is a complete lifestyle address.
